name: opusclip
description: Connect OpusClip to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use OpusClip MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect OpusClip to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with short clips from long videos using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my OpusClip workspace.
Find anything in OpusClip that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review short clips from long videos in OpusClip.
